{{Top|leg}}
The '''Cartann City Air Base''' was a military air base in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Cartann City|Cartann]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]]. It was where a large group of [[Flightknife|flightknives]], aligned with Cartann emerged to take part of the fighting against the forces of the [[Adumari Union]] during the [[Adumari Civil War]].<ref name="soa">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>
